text:
Jordan: T-minus 25 for Rapid Rollout (runtime v3.5.1). Window 18:00-18:45 UTC. Canary plan: 2% -> 10% after 5m if metrics stable. Rollback path prepared. Who's owning smoke, canary watch, and rollback? Reply with your lane and ✅ when ready.

Priya: I'll own smoke + metrics dashboards. Will run sanity commands and keep an eye on p50/p95. ✅

Mateo: I'll handle canary traffic ramp and the routing toggles. Will stand by at 18:05 UTC. ✅

Avery: I'll be on incident rotation for the window (escalation). Staying on until 19:00 UTC. Ping me for anything that looks off. :point_up:

Li: I'll validate DB feature flag toggles and run migration readiness checks. Quick note: make sure `featureX_toggle=false` until canary passes. ✅

Dylan: Rollback owner. If canary fails, I'll run rollback plan and coordinate cutover. Tagged me with @dylan if immediate rollback. ✅

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled at 18:05 UTC (canary-id: canary-267890). Auto-monitoring hooks enabled: latency, error-rate, token-loss. Alerts will post here.

Jordan: Quick smoke checklist (run in order, paste outputs if anything weird):
```
# smoke checks
curl -sS https://smoke.internal/redwood/health | jq .
kubectl --context prod get pods -l app=inference -o wide
# sample generation test
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello world","max_tokens":8}' | jq .
```

Priya: smoke done (18:02). Health: ok, pods: 12/12 ready, sample gen latency 120ms. Posting metric snapshots to dashboard link: https://grafana/redwood/d/xyz

Mateo: canary traffic flip at 18:05 — starting 2% now. Watching cpu, kv-cache hit rate, and token p95.

Priya: Observing a small p95 bump to 210ms at 2% but error-rate 0.0%. No regressive logs so far.

Mateo: After 5m ramping to 10% as planned. Will abort and notify if error-rate >0.5% or p95 >500ms.

Li: Confirmed feature flags remain off. DB migrations queued but not applied.

Dylan: Rollback playbook (short):
```
# rollback steps
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime --to-revision=512
# disable canary routing
deploy-bot rollback canary canary-267890
# post-rollback smoke
curl -sS https://smoke.internal/redwood/health | jq .
```

Jordan: Small gotcha: new kernel selector toggled in config. Mateo, if you see tokenizer OOMs, flip `kernel_selector: stable` back.

Mateo: noted. I saw two transient IO spikes at 18:07 but recovered. Holding at 10% for 10m.

Priya: Metrics good at 10m mark. p95 steady ~130ms, errors 0.01%. Rolling forward to full rollout per plan in 15m unless objections.

Avery: No objections from infra side. I'll keep the on-call channel open.

Dylan: Standby for rollback if alerts fire. Otherwise will confirm finalization once full rollout begins.

Jordan: Thanks team — logging approvals: Priya ✅, Mateo ✅, Li ✅, Dylan ✅, Avery ✅. Proceeding with gradual rollout to full per schedule. Will post final status when complete.

deploy-bot: Canary completed successfully. Full rollout scheduled: 18:25 UTC. All monitoring hooks green.

Mateo: Full rollout started 18:25.

Priya: Post-rollout smoke OK at 18:30. No regressions observed.

Jordan: Closing thread — rollout successful, no rollback needed. Great work all. :tada:
